mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zzl_ai_attachment (file_id, scope, conversation_id, original_name, extension, content_type, size, path, extracted_chars, text_extracted, extract_message, uploaded_at) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{scope}, COALESCE(#{conversationId}, ''), #{originalName}, #{extension}, #{contentType}, #{size}, #{path}, #{extractedChars}, #{textExtracted}, #{extractMessage}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE conversation_id = COALESCE(#{conversationId}, conversation_id), original_name = #{originalName}, extension = #{extension}, content_type = #{contentType}, size = #{size}, path = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{path}, ''), path), extracted_chars = #{extractedChars}, text_extracted = #{textExtracted}, extract_message = #{extractMessage}
mapper.select: SELECT file_id, scope, conversation_id, original_name, extension, content_type, size, path, extracted_chars, text_extracted, extract_message, uploaded_at FROM zzl_ai_attachment WHERE scope = #{scope} AND file_id = #{fileId} LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM zzl_ai_attachment WHERE scope = #{scope} AND file_id = #{fileId}
